name: The Jezero photo mosaic
about: The 21 km orbital photo mosaic that the planning box is cut from, shrunk to 16 m per pixel.
source: USGS Astrogeology, Mars 2020 Terrain Relative Navigation HiRISE Orthorectified Image Mosaic (Fergason et al. 2020), doi:10.5066/P9QJDP48, CC0. Image data: NASA/JPL/University of Arizona
made_from: 2 of every 64 source rows, averaged over blocks of 64 pixels
